decisions.template: Grants effect of Dreaming Gloom Shrine
decisions.reason: The item-specific shrine grants slain-enemy explosions, while the item separately supplies damage gained as chaos. Adding the ordinary Gloom Shrine gain-as modifier again would double count an unrelated effect. No kill rate, victim Life or explosion overlap is inferred.
Time of Need/Ghost Dance recurrence is not activation cooldown. A SkillCooldownBase mapping would mislabel it and cap an arbitrary activation rate. No new event histories are introduced.

limits: These scope decisions do not declare the lines globally effectless or all differing rows explained.
No in-game timing or damage measurement was performed.
